_doc: EIA Natural Gas Weekly Update -- candidate publication Thursdays. URL pattern is deterministic: https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/weekly/archivenew_ngwu/<YYYY>/<MM>_<DD>/. Each entry verified via direct HEAD/GET at corpus build time. 4 holiday gaps in window are documented separately.
note: After 2026-01-22 the EIA NGW listing on /naturalgas/weekly/includes/archive.php has not posted new issues (verified at corpus build time 2026-05-12). Instance window thus ends at 2026-01-22; the scenario carries an explicit 'as-of' temporal anchor and remains valid for any task whose query date is on-or-before 2026-01-22.
